title: Double Drip Apple Rhubarb Crumble Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Double Drip’s Apple Rhubarb crumble is a rich and comforting hug in vape form, loaded with mouth-watering flavour. Sweet baked apples are balanced with the bright, sharp tang of fresh rhubarb, all layered over a rich, buttery crumble base for a deliciously decadent taste of home. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape to your liking. Its 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered vape mod kits and sub-ohm tanks .
